title: Birational pullback preserves line-bundle degree on proper integral curves
statement:
Let $k$ be a field and let $X$ and $X'$ be integral schemes proper over $k$, each of topological Krull dimension one [def-pc-integral-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Let $f:X'\to X$ be a morphism over $k$ that induces an isomorphism between dense open subschemes of $X'$ and $X$. For every invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module $L$ [def-sc-invertible-module], its pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] satisfies
$$\deg_k(f^*L)=\deg_k(L),$$
where on either proper curve $Z$ the degree is $\deg_k(M)=\chi(Z,M)-\chi(Z,\mathcal O_Z)$ [def-pc-degree-line-bundle, def-pc-euler-characteristic]. No smoothness of either curve and no algebraic-closedness of $k$ are required.
